sections.title: 一、完形填空
sections.instruction: 阅读下面短文，从每小题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Sammie Vance knows there's nothing worse than being without friends. For years, she has been helping [1] kids. She is running the Buddy [2] Bench. Anyone who is alone could sit on the buddy bench. It tells other kids he or she needs a [3]. It's helpful to make other people notice someone in need of care.

Sammie thought about the Buddy Bench programme in 2017. First she introduced the [4] to her teachers and parents to get their support. But there have been small challenges, like [5]. To make the cost less and be eco-friendly, Sammie decided to make the bench from recycled materials(回收材料). She called on people to [6] bottle caps. In the end, she got over 1,200 pounds of them. A company called Green Tree Plastics recycled these into three benches. The benches [7] became popular and soon brought kids together. From then on, Sammie helped communities(社区) around the country [8] buddy benches.

Sammie has some changes herself. She has learned to accept her weakness and become a better person. "I used to be really [9]," she says, "but I'm more outgoing now. It helps me [10] in different parts of my life."

Sammie's story shows helping people can start at any age. Even small acts of kindness can be powerful.

questions.translation: 多年来，她一直在帮助孤独的孩子。
questions.explanation: 根据后文“Anyone who is alone could sit on the buddy bench.”可知，Sammie是在帮助孤独、没有朋友的孩子。lonely意为“孤独的”，符合语境。

questions.translation: 她正在运营“伙伴长椅”项目。
questions.explanation: 根据下文“thought about the Buddy Bench programme in 2017”可知，这里指的是Buddy Bench programme（伙伴长椅项目）。

questions.translation: 它告诉其他孩子他或她需要一个朋友。
questions.explanation: 结合上文“being without friends”以及坐在长椅上表达的需求可知，坐在上面的人需要的是朋友（friend）。

questions.translation: 首先她把这个想法介绍给她的老师和父母以获得他们的支持。
questions.explanation: Sammie构想出了伙伴长椅项目，因此她是把这个“想法/主意（idea）”介绍给老师和父母。

questions.translation: 但也遇到了一些小挑战，比如资金问题。
questions.explanation: 根据后文“To make the cost less”（为了降低成本）可知，遇到的挑战与钱/资金（money）有关。

questions.translation: 她号召人们收集瓶盖。
questions.explanation: 根据后文“got over 1,200 pounds of them”（得到了超过1200磅的瓶盖）可知，她是号召大家“收集（collect）”瓶盖。

questions.translation: 这些长椅很快流行起来，不久就把孩子们聚集在了一起。
questions.explanation: 根据并列句中的“soon brought kids together”可知，长椅是“快速地（quickly）”受欢迎。

questions.translation: 从那时起，Sammie帮助全国各地的社区建立伙伴长椅。
questions.explanation: set up意为“设立，建立”，与buddy benches搭配符合语境。

questions.translation: “我过去真的很害羞，”她说，“但我现在性格更外向了。”
questions.explanation: 根据“but I'm more outgoing now”的转折对比可知，过去她很害羞（shy）。

questions.translation: 这有助于我在生活的不同方面成长。
questions.explanation: 结合上文“become a better person”可知，变得外向帮助她在生活各方面取得“成长（grow）”。

sections.title: 二、阅读理解
sections.instruction: 阅读下面短文，从每小题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
What would you do if your best friend and you have different ideas? At first, I didn't know what to do when I found that my best friend Karina disagreed(不同意) with me on some things.

When we first met in a summer camp, we got along so well.

But then something happened at a picnic. "Did you hear about the shopping center news?" asked one of our friends Levar. "They want to cut down lots of trees to make room for a shopping center."

"That's terrible! We have to stop that," I said.

"I disagree," said Karina. "The shopping center would offer new jobs to people in need."

"But animals would lose their homes!" I said. "I want people to have jobs, but it doesn't mean cutting down trees."

I wished Karina could agree with me about saving the trees, but she had her reasons for believing what she said. I was so angry that I didn't talk to her for days.

Later, my mother knew it and said to me, "No two people are the same. You should respect(尊重) each other. And no matter what happens, the difference doesn't mean losing a good friend."

After listening to my mom's words, I said sorry to Karina and we are still good friends now.

questions.prompt: How does the writer start the passage?
questions.translation: 作者是如何开始这篇文章的？
questions.explanation: 文章开头第一句问“What would you do if your best friend and you have different ideas?”，是以提问（By asking a question）开头的。

questions.prompt: According to the passage, what is building the shopping center good for?
options: Giving much money to some people.
Having places for children to have fun.
questions.translation: 根据文章，建造购物中心有什么好处？
questions.explanation: 根据Karina所说的话“The shopping center would offer new jobs to people in need.”可知，建购物中心的好处是给有需要的人提供新工作。

questions.prompt: How did the writer feel when Karina disagreed with her?
questions.translation: 当Karina不同意作者的观点时，作者感觉如何？
questions.explanation: 根据第七段“I was so angry that I didn't talk to her for days.”可知，作者当时非常生气（Angry）。

questions.prompt: What's the main idea of the passage?
options: We can ask our friends for help.
Good friends tell each other everything.
questions.translation: 这篇文章的主旨大意是什么？
questions.explanation: 根据妈妈说的话“You should respect each other. And no matter what happens, the difference doesn't mean losing a good friend.”以及全文核心思想可知，朋友之间应该相互尊重。

sections.title: 三、阅读还原
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，从方框内所给的选项中选出可以填入空白处的最佳选项，其中有一个多余的选项。
sections.passage:
Do you have true friends? Do you want to know better between you and your friends? There are three different kinds of friends: "pest friends", "guest friends", and "best friends".

The first kind of friend is simply the acquaintances (熟人). All you usually know about them is their names. You may meet this kind of friend at school, at work, or on the bus, but you don't miss them when they're not around. [1] That is why they are called "pest friends".

The second kind of friend could also be called "social partners". [2] You know their names, a little of what they like or dislike, and a little of their family histories. You usually have a few things in common, but you don't talk about anything deep, such as your wishes or fears, and they don't open up to you about how they really feel.

The last kind of friend, the "best friends", are the ones you know the deepest. [3] You have no problem staying at each other's houses, and you share your deepest feelings and thoughts. [4] Sometimes they may not be perfect, but at least they will always care about you, and never do anything on purpose(故意地) to hurt you.

[5] We should value(重视) all friendships and remember, all best friends start out as just acquaintances.
wordbank: They are closer than acquaintances, but not as close as best friends.
You have to keep secrets to yourself.
They will help you with your life problems.
You're like family, and know everything about each other.
When this kind of friend does something bad, you don't tell them.
We all have our pest, guest, and best friends.
They will correct you when you're wrong.

questions.answer: When this kind of friend does something bad, you don't tell them.
questions.translation: 当这种朋友做了坏事时，你不会去指出提醒他们。
questions.explanation: 根据上下文，这类朋友只是熟人，所以即使他们做错了事你也不会直说，所以他们被称为pest friends。

questions.answer: They are closer than acquaintances, but not as close as best friends.
questions.translation: 他们比熟人更亲密，但不如挚友那样亲密。
questions.explanation: 第二种朋友是guest friends (social partners)，承上启下，说明他们的亲密程度介于熟人和挚友之间。

questions.answer: You're like family, and know everything about each other.
questions.translation: 你们就像家人一样，了解彼此的一切。
questions.explanation: 空后提到了在对方家里过夜、分享最深的情感，说明彼此就像家人一样了解。

questions.answer: They will help you with your life problems.
questions.translation: 他们会帮助你解决生活中的问题。
questions.explanation: 形容挚友（best friends）的特点，会在生活中给予实质帮助。

questions.answer: We all have our pest, guest, and best friends.
questions.translation: 我们都有属于自己的这三种朋友。
questions.explanation: 位于结尾段开头，总结全文介绍的三种朋友类型。

sections.title: 四、任务型阅读
sections.instruction: 阅读下面诗歌及短文，按要求完成下列各题。
sections.passage:
You always answer when I call,
And help me up if I fall,
But you never complain(抱怨) at all,
My true friend.
You know the funny things to say,
To make me laugh,
To make my fears(害怕) away,
Like the sun, you brighten my day,
My true friend.
You always know what I need,
And give it to me before I plead(乞求),
Just like a book, my mind you read,
My true friend.
And greatest of all I have found,
When times are hard and I'm down,
You are the one who stays around,
My true friend.

questions.prompt: What is the best title for this poem?
questions.translation: 这首诗的最佳标题是什么？
questions.explanation: 诗歌每一节末尾都重复出现“My true friend”，全文表达对真正朋友的感激与赞美，故最佳标题为“My True Friend”。

questions.prompt: Which line in the poem has the same meaning as "The sun can make me bright, and so can you."?
options: Like the sun, you brighten my day
You always know what I need
Just like a book, my mind you read
questions.translation: 诗中哪一句与“太阳能带给我光明，你也能”同义？
questions.explanation: “Like the sun, you brighten my day”意为“就像太阳一样，你照亮了我的一天”，与题目中的句子同义。

questions.prompt: What does "my mind you read" mean in Chinese according to the poem?
questions.translation: 根据诗歌，“my mind you read”的中文意思是什么？
questions.explanation: 这里采用了倒装句“you read my mind”，意为“你能读懂我的内心”。

questions.prompt:
According to the poem, which set of words correctly completes the following summary?
"My true friend always answers when I call and helps me ____ if I fall. He always says something ____ to make me laugh. He is like the sun to ____ my day. He knows what I need. He is always with me when I'm ____. Thank you, my true friend."
questions.translation: 根据诗歌，哪一组词语能正确填空总结短文？
questions.explanation: 对照诗歌原文：① helps me up if I fall (填up); ② know the funny things to say (填funny); ③ brighten my day (填brighten); ④ when times are hard and I'm down (填down)。对应选项A。
